description: Aggregates council_verdict (7-agent consensus), technical_indicators (RSI/MACD/BB), funding_rates, fear_greed and hype_signal into a single -100 to +100 score with a strong_buy/buy/neutral/sell/strong_sell classification. Includes Kelly-sized position when bankroll is given, entry/stop/target levels and warnings. 0.02 USDC per call via x402.

bankroll.description: Optional portfolio size for Kelly sizing

chain.description: solana, ethereum, base, polygon, arbitrum or bsc

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.

name: composite_signal
